faqs.question: What is the eligibility to get admission in A.R.J College of Engineering and Technology (ARJCET) for UG/PG courses?
faqs.answer:
A.R.J College of Engineering and Technology (ARJCET) has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.E. / B.Tech Candidate must have passed Diploma in relevant stream from a recognised Institute.
MBA/PGDM Candidate must have completed Bachelor's degree of minimum 3 years duration with minimum 50% (45 % for reserved category). The qualifying degree examination can be 10+2+3/4/5 years pattern or 10+3 years Diploma +3 years pattern or B.E./B.Tech./B.Arch./B.Pharm. or 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE. AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field. Candidates admitted through Lateral Entry in degree courses are not eligible. Candidates with degree obtained without studying 10th/12th Std. or 3 years degree programme are not eligible. Candidates appearing for the final semester/year are also eligible.
MCA Candidate must have completed Bachelor's degree of minimum 3 years duration with minimum 50% (45 % for reserved category). Candidate must have mathematics subject at 10+2 or at Graduate level. The qualifying degree examination can be 10+2+3/4/5 years pattern or 10+3 years Diploma +3 years pattern or 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE. AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field. Candidates with B.E./B.Tech. degrees obtained through Distance/Weekend mode are not eligible. Candidates with degree obtained without studying 10th/12th Std. or 3 years degree programme are not eligible. Candidates appearing for the final semester/year are also eligible.
M.E./M.Tech Candidate must have completed B.E/B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engg. Candidate belonging to reserved category must have 45% in qualifying examination. Candidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible. AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field. Candidates with B.E./B.Tech. degrees obtained through Distance/Weekend mode are not eligible. Candidates with degree obtained without studying 10th/12th Std. or 3 years degree programme are not eligible. Candidates appearing for the final semester/year are also eligible.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The low-fee college with great infrastructure.

content.Placements: The placement provided by our college was not too good for Engineering students. Only a few companies were collaborated for placements. Tata Motors and Mahindra are the well-known companies that visited my college for the last two years. The average salary package was 1.25 L.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms and labs are very neat and clean for our department, but some of the computers were not in working condition for other departments. The hostel has green surroundings, and the room was spacious for 2 persons. The food was not too good, but it's okay. The college contains a ground where we can play various sports like cricket, volleyball, football, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: A. R. J College of Engineering and Technology is a really good college.

content.Placements: A. R. J College of Engineering and Technology has very good placement records. Every year, more than 90% of students are placed in more reputed MNC companies. The average salary packages range from INR 2.5 to 8 LPA. This college has a dedicated placement cell. I am placed in TVS Company through the college's campus interviews.
content.Infrastructure: This college has good classroom facilities, with projectors available in all classrooms. The latest technology-based machines and laboratories are also available here. There is a good library and auditorium facility as well. The college has several sports grounds. Boys' and girls' hostels are also available, and the hostel food is very hygienic.

overview_faqs.question: Is Jagannath Community College a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Jagannath Community College is a reputed institute for Certificate, B.Voc, UG Diploma, BBA, BBM/BMS, BCA, M.Sc., B.Sc., B.Des, MBA/PGDM, B.A. (Hons), B.Com, B.FTech, BHM, M.A. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, Banking, Finance & Insurance, Hospitality & Travel, Design, IT & Software, Science, Accounting & Commerce, Engineering, Mass Communication & Media, Humanities & Social Sciences, Architecture & Planning. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. Jagannath Community College has a review rating of 3.2 on the basis of reviews by students. In addition to this, it has been rated 3 on campuslife, 2.9 on placements, 3.8 on faculty and 3.4 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Jagannath Community College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Psychology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The faculty is good, the management could be better, but it's okay otherwise.

content.Placements: They didn't offer placements for fields of psychology except industrial, which I didn't take, so I didn't know much about it. But internships provided by the college were good, valuable, and really knowledgeable, they lasted for over a month, so according to that, it was good.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, library, air-conditioned classes, computer labs, and canteens were available. Washrooms were hygienic too. However, the campus was a bit small, so there was no place to hang out as such, and they didn't let you sit in the garden area or canteens if you had a free lecture. Entry and exit rules were also a bit strict.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college for a degree only.

content.Placements: Placements of this college are not so bad or not so good. As a student of this college, I came to know that the placements are not for all the students, and these are for only those who secured a good CGP in exams or the attendance criteria are fulfilled for 75%. No big companies came here. The average package ranges from 3-4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has quite good infrastructure. There are good and maintained library and computer labs. The college campus has its own 3 canteens, and the lunch facility for hostel students is different. Classes are fully AC and clean. The college has a small area for playing outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English Literature - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great opportunities are given to students.

content.Placements: The majority of my seniors went for proper internships where they were getting paid. Recruiting companies are Muskurahat Foundation, Project Guru, etc. I'll be currently going for my summer internships, so I would not be the best person to speak on placements.
content.Infrastructure: They have well-built classrooms and infrastructure is fine. The quality of food in the canteen is also nice. There are a variety of dishes in canteen like pasta, sandwiches, maggi, coffee, etc. There are four floors in total. There are many departments like psychology, English, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, you can consider the college for undergraduates.

content.Placements: Around 90% of the students got placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. There are many start-ups for entrepreneurial minds and internships are also available. With some hard work and dedication, you can easily grab an opportunity for both internships and placements.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are available outside the campus which is owned by the college itself for both boys and girls separately. They are clean and well-managed by the college. Food quality is good and washrooms are also available. You do have options of PG nearby which are also affordable and accessible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Good college and good facility.

content.Placements: So basically, this college provides internships and also placements for sales and marketing, and they also provide financing jobs, but they don't provide good packages. The lowest package will be up to 2.50 Lacs and the highest 6 to 8,00,000. HR jobs provided by the college are the best.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very advanced, and talking about the hostel, it is one of the best private hostels. Yes, it is expensive, but the facilities provided by them are amazing, like good food, Wi-Fi, washrooms, and cleanliness.

The admission process at Samalkha Group of Institutions for the academic year 2025 begins with the application process. Prospective candidates are required to download the application form from the official website of the institution. Upon completion, the filled application form needs to be submitted either via post or in person to the designated department at SGI. Additionally, candidates must pay the application and entrance test fees online and attach the pay slip along with two copies of the online bank challan to the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds
Admission to the various UG and PG courses offered at Samalkha Group of Institutions is based on a combination of merit and entrance tests. The selection criteria vary depending on the course:
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

Following the completion of the selection rounds, qualified candidates will be called for counselling sessions specific to their respective courses. Subsequently, SGI will release merit lists in multiple rounds, featuring the names of selected candidates. Students whose names appear on the merit list must pay the required fees to secure their seats in the desired course.

reviews.review_heading: An enriching academic experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-maintained and well-structured. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors. Lab facilities provide many software programs. reviews.review_heading: About campus life and learning experience.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college provides a good learning experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-maintained and well-structured. Hostel facilities are good. Along with many basic amenities such as Wi-Fi and free housekeeping. Hostel is decent, clean, and safe. Basic medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: This is about academics, exposure, and student experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Campus has a pleasant vibe and a good environment. Each department is fully equipped with smart classroom systems. Laboratories have many software programs and are well-maintained. The hostel provides safe, clean, and secure accommodation with many facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides excellent facilities for students’ overall growth and development.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides separate centrally air-cooled residential facilities for both boys and girls. The hostel includes a common room with a TV. The mess is hygienic, and the food is very tasty with lots of variety. Safety is a priority, with 24/7 wardens acting as local guardians for the residents. Without permission, no one can enter the premises. In short, SGI provides a safe and secure environment.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the internship and placement.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is well maintained and modern. Campus has classrooms with proper lighting and ventilation. Smart classrooms, well equipped laboratories, a seminar hall, and a big library are available. A variety of books and journals are in the library. Food in the hostel is acceptable. A large variety of food is offered. College also provides medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A student's perspective on academic and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-maintained and well-equipped with smart boards and a smart classroom system. The quality of food they provide us in the hostel is good. The food is tasty. Every day we are getting different types of dishes. The canteen is near our hostel.

reviews.review_heading: My college journey experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-maintained and well-structured. Labs and classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors. Hostel facilities provided are good. They provide us with good food in proper and hygienic manner. Mess, canteen, and medical facilities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: My college journey overall with good experience.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well-maintained and well-structured. The facilities provided by the college are fine. Labs are equipped by no. of instruments. Our classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors. The quality of food is good, and mess is fully hygienic. They provide separate medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: BBA course and my college life.
reviews.review_text: It is a fully Wi-Fi campus. Its infrastructure is too large, and its maintenance is also good. Here, teachers give lectures via PPT presentations through projectors. Labs are fully equipped. In the library, we get both options of offline and online modes. Well-furnished hostel facilities are available for students. In short, there are separate and secure hostels.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure of the college is very good, and on the other hand, the faculty is very helpful.
reviews.review_text: As a first year BBA student, my experience with the college facilities and infrastructure has been quite positive so far. The campus is well-maintained, and the environment is student-friendly. Our classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors and Wi-fi, which makes it easier to follow lectures and presentations. The college provides decent infrastructure for academic and day-to-day needs.

reviews.review_heading: Samalkha Group of institutions helps students prepare for the future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well. From the academic building to the library block, everything is maintained properly. The college campus is so green and clean we have all the facilities like the library, labs, and canteen. The Samalkha Group of institutions has various sports facilities like indoor games and outdoor games. The college conducts games and competitions for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college academics are strong with supportive faculty and regular assessments.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is large, and B. Tech students have their separate blocks. We have a common library for all students. The campus offers amenities like air-conditioned classrooms, a good library, a canteen, hostels, and sports grounds. In my classroom, all facilities are available, including a smart board and projector.

individual_reviews.course: MCA - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with whatever I learned and experienced over there.

content.Placements: Only 10% of students get placed in our course. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA. The average salary package offered is 2 LPA. Placements are offered in companies like iNeuron, etc., with roles like data analyst and web developer. I did an extra course for data science from iNeuron company which is based in Bangalore.
content.Infrastructure: Limited facilities are available in the college. It has only one computer lab and limited systems, so students face a lot of problems. The quality of the hostel is not good, especially for boys. Unhealthy food is served to students failing to protect their health, and they have to skip classes.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. English - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College was good because of teachers.

content.Placements: In 2023, around 20% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered was 14 LPA and the lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. It all depends on students's talent. Top recruiting companies were Cluster University and IUST. Almost 10% of students secured internships from our course. Top roles offered in our course was English lecturer.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were decent, no smart boards or Wi-Fi, but there was a library that we could only access from 8:00 AM-5:00 PM. Hostel rooms were decent, with three beds, and we had to compromise on space and other things. Food was not too good, but medical facilities were quite satisfactory.

review_summary.college_name: IIFD Kolkata Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Interior Designing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best fashion design college. Very professional staff and faculty.

content.Placements: Top recruiting companies include Zara, Times of India, Raymond, Disney, and many more. Students also get opportunities with boutique labels, fashion brands, and houses, and even international internships in select cases. IIFD has a big name in providing good industry placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is up-to-date and modern. The infrastructure supports a good balance of creativity, comfort, and professionalism. For medical emergencies, there is proper first aid and health room. Food at the hostel is quite good and hygienic, and the taste is acceptable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Fashion-focused learning with strong placements and events.

content.Placements: I am in 2nd year of my course B.Des 4-year degree program. I have only been listening to my seniors and teachers, who have almost all their students placed this year. Top roles offered include fashion stylist, designer assistant, merchandiser, and even visual branding associate roles.
content.Infrastructure: I want to say IIFD is the best place to start your journey. The campus is quite modern and full of all the needed amenities. Our department has dedicated fashion labs, pattern-making studios, illustration rooms, and full Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. The hostel facilities are clean, secure, and comfortable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Fashion Designing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great fashion exposure and placement opportunities!

content.Placements: The college offers an excellent learning atmosphere with experienced teachers and updated labs that make every day an exciting journey in fashion education. From what I have seen and based on recent placement results, 97 to 99% of students got placed in fashion design degree courses. I saw that the highest package is 47 LPA and the average package is 11 LPA. Some students even got international placements and reputed fashion house offers, which is really motivating.
content.Infrastructure: All things are good in our college. Our fashion design department at IIFD Kolkata is very well. Classrooms are modern with good projectors and ACs. Wi-Fi is available which is most necessary in today's education. The fashion studios have proper things like mannequins, draping tools, sewing machines, and mood board areas.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good. Everything is awesome.

content.Placements: The college has 99% placement with salaries from 8-10 LPA. It partners with major brands, fashion houses, Marks and Spencer, etc. There is a 99 percent internship rate for students every year. Every year, they host fashion shows, which provide a great platform for studies and help students learn about fashion.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good. The classrooms have smart boards, Wi-Fi, and we also have our production rooms. The rooms are divided into many parts. In the hostel, we are happy with the facilities; two students share one room, but each room feels like home. Every morning, we receive breakfast. However, the timings for entering the hostel are a bit strict.

reviews.review_text: The campus is up-to-date and modern. The infrastructure supports a good balance of creativity, comfort, and professionalism. For medical emergencies, there is proper first aid and health room. Food at the hostel is quite good and hygienic, and the taste is acceptable.

reviews.review_heading: Fashion-focused learning with strong placements and events.
reviews.review_text: I want to say IIFD is the best place to start your journey. The campus is quite modern and full of all the needed amenities. Our department has dedicated fashion labs, pattern-making studios, illustration rooms, and full Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. The hostel facilities are clean, secure, and comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Great fashion exposure and placement opportunities!
reviews.review_text: All things are good in our college. Our fashion design department at IIFD Kolkata is very well. Classrooms are modern with good projectors and ACs. Wi-Fi is available which is most necessary in today's education. The fashion studios have proper things like mannequins, draping tools, sewing machines, and mood board areas.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good. Everything is awesome.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good. The classrooms have smart boards, Wi-Fi, and we also have our production rooms. The rooms are divided into many parts. In the hostel, we are happy with the facilities; two students share one room, but each room feels like home. Every morning, we receive breakfast. However, the timings for entering the hostel are a bit strict.

highlights.summary: IITM Group of Institutions, Sonipat, Powered by Sunstone was founded in 2010. It is a private institute and is located in Sonepat, Haryana. IITM Group of Institutions, Sonipat, Powered by Sunstone courses are offered to students at the UG and PG levels. The institute offers courses in Full Time mode. IITM Group of Institutions, Sonipat, Powered by Sunstone offers a total of 5 courses in streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies and IT & Software. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are B.E. / B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, BCA and BBA. These courses are offered to students across several specialisation such as Computer Science Engineering. Further, the fee for all these courses ranges between INR 2,65,000 to 4,50,000. Apart from this, the IITM Group of Institutions, Sonipat, Powered by Sunstone campus has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with all the advanced facilities.

placement_data.title: Hindustan College of Arts and Science Powered by Sunstone Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placement drive for season 2025 at Hindustan College of Arts and Science Powered by Sunstone recorded the highest package of INR 26 LPA. The average package offered to the graduating batch of 2025 was INR 4.6 LPA . The season recorded more than 1 200 recruiters and the ROI was 63% higher . Leading recruiters that took part in the recruitment process include- HDFC, Amul, Wipro and many more.

Sunstone’s Placement Opportunity Program (POP) provides students with access to over 200 guaranteed placement opportunities, or they can receive a refund of their first-year tuition if the placements do not fulfill the commitment. To qualify for POP, students need to maintain at least a 70% average attendance in all credit and non-credit classes each semester. They must also pass all exams with a minimum score of 80% or an equivalent CGPA, and they should not have any backlogs. Furthermore, students must ensure that all fee payments are made according to the schedule specified in the offer letter. Finally, students are required to strictly follow the Sunstone Placement Policy Guidelines throughout the duration of the program.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: James college of engineering and technology review.

content.Placements: We are provided with the placement from a production core company. The company Was quite good and we get a good experience there. We are provided with a placement training where we can get a better knowledge about the placement. Aptitude Question and reasoning Question are practiced in our session of placement.
content.Infrastructure: The College is provided with a Good environment and Neat classrooms. The library is neat and tidy arranged with Several number of useful books. Having a wide play ground at the centre. Provided with a neat hostel room. The environment here is completely fine and it provides us a green nature.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2012

content.Other: Worst college, if there is any minus rating, I will surely hit that button. They are very tricky people. They will give RS 20,000 to agents who brought you there. Don’t fall in their promises, even the prospectus is fake. There are no permanent lecturers and internal evaluation is not proper. I am from Kerala, I feel discrimination from some teachers, and they show more empathy towards Tamil students in every possible way. There was no placement programme, career assistance, project assistance, no industry-linked programmes, no exhibitions, industry visit, no paper presentation, no case studies and nothing that can stimulate interpersonal skill needed by a management graduate. Plus points: good hostel and food, good library (no E library). Joining this college will put your future in a black hole.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is a perfect college for students to fulfil their dreams.

content.Placements: Almost 60% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA, and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 10,000 per month. The top recruiting company of our college is Microsoft. Top roles offered to the students are manager and HR. In our course, the highest salary offered is 1 lac per month and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 30,000 per month. Almost 70% of the students got an internship.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good infrastructure, nature and green covered place. Hostel food is very good and delicious. The library is very good, and there are many books. Classrooms have decent looks, and there is more speciality like Wi-Fi connection is always available that you can use at any time. It is a very good college and campus with lush green and natural place.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth to consider Sree Chaitanya Institute of Technological Sciences (SCITS) as a good Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Sree Chaitanya Institute of Technological Sciences (SCITS) is a reputed institute for B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Engineering, Business & Management Studies. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. As per Shiksha verified reviews, Sree Chaitanya Institute of Technological Sciences (SCITS) has a rating of 4 on the basis of reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 4.3 on campuslife, 3.7 on placements, 4 on faculty and 4 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Sree Chaitanya Institute of Technological Sciences (SCITS) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good in everything, and the environment is also good.

content.Placements: 20% of students are placed, with the package offered between 4-5 LPA by the companies. The recruiting company is TCS, and the role offered is data scientist.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has good classrooms with projectors and enough seating. The labs are well-equipped and useful for practical learning. Wi-Fi is available in most areas, and the library has plenty of books, journals, and digital resources. Overall, the facilities are good for both study and research. The college has grounds for cricket, football, basketball, and volleyball. Indoor games like table tennis and badminton are also available. A gym is present for fitness.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely one of the failed education systems.

content.Placements: Not even 10:1 of people are getting jobs in our college. This college doesn’t get jobs at all. This is the worst college I have ever seen. Most of the time, we don’t get jobs in this college. This is the worst college in India. It is a waste of time to join.
content.Infrastructure: We have various labs in our college, but the computers or the equipment do not work at all. This is the most disappointing part of our college. There is a Wi-Fi connection, but it does not connect or work. If at all it works, they don’t allow us to use this connection.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I definitely refer our college to my juniors.

content.Placements: We have nice placements. Since our second year, our college has provided CRT classes so we are ready to attend any kind of job tests. Our pre-placement officer is very friendly and comes to every student and knows about their interests, and also provides a route for them.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure with plenty of labs. It also provides all facilities for students. We have skilled lab facilities for explaining programs and also telling how to fix errors, and help to learn new programming languages and provide documentation for them.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Really good for the local and state background students.

content.Placements: Good for the local students who pass their intermediate or diploma from Tier 3 colleges. Not suited for IIT students. Students who want to score good marks and gain knowledge will have to be on their own potential rather than depending on the college faculty.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and interior college things are not well, compared to top colleges. Everything is fine in the college except for education. Good for the local students who pass their intermediate or diploma from Tier 3 colleges. Not suited for IIT students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Students should get above 80 in the ECE course. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA in our electronic and communication engineering. Almost 80% of students got internships. Top recruiting companies are Tata, Wipro, Infosys, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have all facilities in our college. The infrastructure of our college is very good. We have the perfect Wi-Fi and separate labs for each subject. There are comfortable classrooms and a peaceful library. It has all the engineering books which help to study.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I recommend others to take admission in this college.

content.Placements: Hello there, current I'm a student at the FORTE group of institutions. There are about 40% of students who have chosen the Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA). Last year, the highest package was about INR 6 lacs per year. I will highly recommend that students take admission in this course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has provided us with better study space than any other in Meerut. College has a library where we can study with calm minds. The companies that are approaching us at college are not providing us with that much better. Students are working really hard to get their placements.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and provides good facilities.

content.Placements: About 79% of students in our course are placed. The highest salary offered is Rs. 45000 per month, the lowest is Rs. 15000 per month, and the average is Rs. 25000 per month. Around 76% of students got internships from our course. Many companies come here to hire students. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Clovia, etc. Every year, the number of placements increases.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are provided. The quality of food available in the canteen and mess is very good. The infrastructure is good. Sports and games are also conducted on our college campus. Medical facilities are available. A ground is also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Future of India is in FIT Group.

content.Placements: A very low percentage of students get placed. In my batch, most of the students belong to rural areas which affects their language and body language. There are most of the Hindi medium students except 4-5 English medium students. No one speaks in the English language.
content.Infrastructure: Average facilities are available. Classrooms are very small and the seating arrangement is very the worst. There is no Wi-Fi facility in college which is very important for students. There are no labs except computer lab which is very small like a classroom. There is no water purifier.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is not good.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA. There are no internships in this college. Our college recommends low companies. There are around 50-60 students, but only 1-2 students are selected. MCA and MBA courses are also available.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, hostel facilities are not good, because this college cannot have a hostel this year. Mess is also not available. It also provides a small canteen, and the food quality is average.
content.Faculty: Students give their sessional exam 10 days before the final exam. Our course curriculum is relevant, but it does not make students industry-ready. The pass percentage is 32%. Teachers are not good to explain things, but they are knowledgeable.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Placement, Faculty And about hostel etc.

content.Placements: Placement is very good In higher companies Student percentage is 65% to sufficient to higher companies the lowest package is 10000 per month to 500000 per month 80% student got internship and companies like amazon Microsoft etc. B.Tech is Java, Python, C, And C+ .
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good in B.Tech Labs are good And the system is also good Classroom library Hostel facilities are food quality is good and the room was neat and cleaned Hostel Timing are set for student wake up early for studying and fitness.

review_summary.college_name: Seth Vishambhar Nath Group of Educational Institutions Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: This college provides high skills for particular courses.

content.Placements: Almost 75 percent of college students get placed, which is based on skills and knowledge. The average package is 14 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Tata, TCS, Mahindra, Tech, etc. This institute provides good knowledge for teaching careers because they make a genius.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good in this college. Labs are very advanced according to technology. All types of subject labs are available in this college with a focus on practical knowledge. This institute provides a good environment for making good engineers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent college, and I recommend everyone take admission to our college.

content.Placements: Our college has good placements. Top recruiting companies visit our campus. Top recruiting companies like Krishna, Maruti, IBM, etc., visit our campus.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are good. The hostel fee is Rs. 10,000 for 3 months.
content.Faculty: Our faculty members are good. Semester exams are average. Classes are held regularly.
content.Other: The campus surroundings are good. Our college organises many events. Every year, we celebrate farewell and annual functions.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Best college for economically weak students.

content.Placements: 20 to 30% students are placed in my course. The average package of students in my college is 5 LPA, minimum is 1.50 LPA and maximum is 8 LPA. Top companies like Wipro, HP and Infocom visit here. 30% students got internship from my course in Motherson Noida. Top role offered is of executive engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure like office, classrooms, laps and workshops are maintained. All the departments are separate in my college. Many students live in hostel and the mess food is really awesome. Canteen is also provided and a cafeteria area is present. Some activities are organized in the college. Sports and games are also organized.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: This college has good faculty and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: We can't get any placement. But we see previous year students getting placement. The highest package in the previous year is 10 LPA. There are many top recruiting companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Dell, Hitachi, swiggy, and many more. There are many top roles offered to selected students as per their qualifications and knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: All teachers have a good amount of knowledge of their respective subjects. The whole college is surrounded by Wi-Fi. There are many labs for different types of studies. Classrooms are always clean and well maintained. There is a library and you can also take a book from there and study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides education at a very affordable price.

content.Placements: Around 60-70% of students in every course are placed, but it is high for the CS branch. The highest salary package is 10 LPA and the lowest salary package is 2.5 LPA. The average salary package is around 4 LPA. Many reputable companies, such as Byjus, Just Dial, and Amazon, come to my college for campus placement.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good and we have two big playgrounds for students. All of our classes are equipped with CCTV and light fans. Our library is also very good. You can easily access what you need related to your course. I don't know very much about hostels because I didn't live there.

individual_reviews.course: B.F.Sc. in Fisheries Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good facilities are available.

content.Placements: Above 80% students got internships. Top recruiting companies are Matsyafed (Kerala State Cooperative Federation for fisheries development Ltd. ), Innovafeed, CIFNET, and CMFRI. High job opportunities in the Kerala Fisheries Sector. Above 80% students are placed in the course.
content.Infrastructure: Well-developed facilities. For the semester, girls don't get a hostel. The government gives an amount to support those students. The food at private hostels is not good. The campus hostel has much better food than the private hostel. There are good classrooms with smart class ICAR-sponsored classrooms.

individual_reviews.course: B.F.Sc. in Fisheries Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Life in KUFOS: The campus crowd is less. Entrepreneurs can take the course.

content.Placements: 70% to 90% of students got placed in the fisheries course. The average package is 3-7 LPA. The highest package can reach up to 12 LPA for specialized roles in research or management positions at reputed companies. The lowest package for entry-level jobs may offer around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Neospark, Gadre Marine, and CP. Around 70% of students got internships in marine research centres, aquariums, and conservation projects. Aquaculturist, fish hatchery manager, fisheries officer, farm manager, fisheries extension officer, fishery biologist, aquatic biologist, fish feed mill manager, research scientist, and fisheries inspector are top roles offered in the fisheries course.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: . Good infrastructure and faculty members .

content.Placements: 30 percentage of students are placed in an year the highest package offered was about to 60000 And the lowest was about to 15000 50 Percentage of students get internship to milma, pavizham price mill. The top offered in the cource was quality controller .
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are helpful for all our problems and they will inform all the messages we want In our college Wi-Fi access will provide quickly And we have a good collection of books in library We have a full facilities in class And we have separate labs for subjects.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Technology (M.Tech) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Strong program for marine and coastal engineering.

content.Placements: M.Tech program at our college has been an exciting and enriching experience. The placement scenario was promising, around 75% of students secured jobs in leading companies. The highest package offered was 12 LPA. The average package was around 7 LPA. The lowest was around 3 LPA. Renault recruiters like India put association Adani port and other organisations. Internships with around 70% of students working with port authorities, off-shore engineering firms, and research organisation.
content.Infrastructure: The department was well-equipped with specialized lab for hydrodynamics, marine geotechnics, and sediment transport studies. Students got access to high-simulation software like and MIKE21, DELFT3D, ANSYS for research and project work with extensive study materials journals, and case studies. Hostels provided comfortable living environment with Wi-Fi uninterrupted, power supply, continuous water, and well-maintained facilities. The food provided was decent and students could also enjoy sports facilities, medical care, and extracurricular activities on the campus.

individual_reviews.course: M.F.Sc. in Aquaculture - Batch of 2021

content.Placements: Marine Biology programme October college provide a good career opportunities. More than 75% of the students got placed successfully. The highest salary was 10 Lacs and the lowest was 4 Lacs per annum, and the average was 6 Lacs per annum. Around 70% of the students got internship in Marine research centre, aquariums, and conservation project.

overview_faqs.question: Is Ideal College of Arts and Sciences a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Ideal College of Arts and Sciences is a reputed institute for MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., B.Com, B.A., B.Voc, BBA, BCA. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Business & Management Studies, Science, Accounting & Commerce, Humanities & Social Sciences, IT & Software. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. Ideal College of Arts and Sciences has a review rating of 4.1 on the basis of reviews by students. In addition to this, it has been rated 4 on campuslife, 4 on placements, 4.4 on faculty and 4.5 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Ideal College of Arts and Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Mathematics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Ideal college of arts and sciences review.

content.Placements: We can get placements with our skills, but the lecturer rules us on campus; if we can't follow the rules, they stop the placements. We can get low package placements, and we can enjoy our degree life in our college. Our college is full of fun.
content.Infrastructure: They are the best. Our college has a 100-computer lab, and with good infrastructure and good classrooms, 24/7 hostel facility parking, and a canteen with all varieties, we can't get bored of living on campus. It feels like living in a public park with lots of trees and plants.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Food Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure, facilities, and placements.

content.Placements: Around 60% of students get placed in this course. The highest salary package offered is 2.6 LPA. Top recruiting company is Unibic. Around 50% of students get internships. All the students of our college get jobs. Management of our college gives training for students to do their best during internships.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides sophisticated labs, a library, and wide classrooms with a peaceful environment. Wi-Fi is available for every department. Hostel food has some issues, but the environment of the hostel is very good. Mobile phones are allowed in the hostel. Management of our college is very particular with students living in the hostel. They take good care of students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Food Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Everything is awesome in my college.

content.Placements: Of course, top companies are giving a great opportunity to the students by giving placements, and my seniors got a 12 LPA salary package, and also provide skills that are required for the job interviews and other curricular activities and seminars by the top companies.
content.Infrastructure: Everything was good, but food tasted bad, and warden did not support to students. This is all about my college hostel, but rooms are very clean, it depends on us. Hostel environment is very awesome, and they give us freedom, and we feel like a family. But the problem is that the hostel fee was not worth it.

content.Infrastructure: We have a well maintained library and basic facilities were available. We have The hostel and food in mess are okay and canteen is very peaceful place in overall college, we have well-equipped labs and decent Wi-Fi setting, maintatence in some areas needs improvement.

individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied due to lack of faculty and not proper classes are held.

content.Placements: Some students got placed in IT industry with the lowest salary package. Wipro, Infosys etc. are the companies visit for placement. Around 99% of students completed internships at different companies like Airobosoft Pvt limited, Zyfer Manglore and many. Designing and software development are the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: We have good infrastructure for labs, classrooms, and library. Some are staying in government hostels and some are in college hostel. Food is not bad at hostel and good medical facilities. In government hostel food is not so expected but still getting every facility provided by government.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I'm dissatisfied with the faculty and facilities of our college.

content.Placements: In our college placements, 5 students got placed in our course. Tata consultancy services, and Capgemini were the top companies that came to our college for recruitment. The highest salary package that was offered is 5lLPA, the lowest package is 2LPA and the average package is 3LPA. In our college, nearly 50% Of students got internships. Students will get placed with off-campus opportunities during their last year
content.Infrastructure: Our campus was not equipped with a Wi-Fi connection. The classrooms, library, and labs were good. The food available in the canteen was good, but it was expensive. The college is not very nice to choose from. The hostel and the college are both located somewhere in different locations, and the college is not provided with good facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Aeronautical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with the placements and there is no proper education system.

content.Placements: There are no placements, lecturers, faculty, and labs. There is no proper facility and college management attracts you by saying free college fees and that they will provide scholarships but they will never help once you get the admission. Many students are stuck with this.
content.Infrastructure: There is no hostel for the engineering students and no proper food. They charge Rs.70,000 for the hostel but there is no food, proper rooms, Wi-Fi, labs, and proper classrooms. A good library is available.
content.Faculty: Teachers are a bit helpful and qualified and their teaching quality is not at all good. The pass percentage is 50%. Some of the teachers who have completed their Ph.D. are countable. They act to be too strict but not proper.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college because of its good faculty members.

content.Placements: Some companies visit the campus selection to select the eligible students from the computer science and electronics, and communications branches. In this college, only software companies visited in the previous year. Due to the COVID-19, there were no campus placements in the college.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a hospital on the campus. It provides all facilities. The canteen is available, and it serves a variety of food. Sports are conducted by the university yearly.
content.Faculty: In the electronics and communication department, all faculty members are highly qualified. They do not show an attitude to the students. They are friendly, and they explain concepts easily to understand students. Semester exams are not difficult to pass because we study in internal exams. Our branch has 8 faculty members. They are awesome, and we can easily understand the syllabus.

content.Placements: A total of 75% of students from our college got placed. High salary packages are provided by the company. Top recruiting companies here are Reliance, Mahindra, Tata, etc. About 75% of total students got internships in top companies, and companies like Wipro, etc., visit here for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Bhagwati Institute of Management and Technology is situated in Meerut. The vision of BIMT is to evolve a system of education, which is a flexible value-based system of learning. There is Wi-Fi for 24 hours, clean labs, neat and clean classrooms and a well-maintained library.

content.Placements: There are no placements in this college. Our college life is like school. Internships are also not offered at this college.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus environment is good. It also provides a good library with old model books. Science laboratory is available. It also provides 1 GB of data daily. Digital classrooms are also available. Our college does not provide hostels. The canteen facility is average. Sports and games are not conducted.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are helpful. Semester exams are moderate, and the pass percentage is 33%. The course curriculum is relevant to make students ready for the industry.
